records.text: The unidentified fundraising clip speaker said participation in the Commit 100 program was surging after news of the statue vandalism. Personal identity is unresolved in the cleaned transcript.

appearances.snippet: I will tell you what the enemy intended for evil, God is using for good. I want to praise so many of you out there. After this news broke, the Commit 100 program that we've been pushing on this program is surging. ... Please throw it up. But get involved. The people have surged to our Commit 100 program. And so God bless you guys.
